# Beat The Scam

> Independent, plain-English UK consumer-protection publication covering scams, fraud, and checks to run before paying. Guides use AI-assisted drafting followed by editorial review and an automated accuracy gate.

## Research and datasets

- [Research index](https://beatthescam.com/research/): recurring search-discovery and AI-citation reports with downloadable normalized data
- [Research methodology](https://beatthescam.com/research/methodology/): collection cadence, source definitions, interpretation rules and limitations
- [UK Scam Guidance Visibility Report — July 2026](https://beatthescam.com/research/uk-scam-search-ai-trends-2026-07/): An original monthly snapshot of how UK scam guidance is discovered in Google Search and cited across Microsoft Copilot, Bing AI answers and selected partners.

## Guides

### Crypto Scams

- [Binance Impersonation Scam UK: Spot a Fake Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/binance-impersonation-scam-uk/): Fake Binance emails and texts claim your account is suspended, to steal your login. Binance's own Verify tool confirms if a message is genuine.
- [Bitcoin ATM Scam UK: Why a Caller Sending You to One Is a Scam](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bitcoin-atm-scam-uk/): Scammers pose as your bank or HMRC and walk you to a Bitcoin ATM to 'secure' your money. No genuine official will ask you to do this.
- [Bitcoin Scam UK: Spot a Fake Crypto Investment](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bitcoin-scam-uk/): Approached about a Bitcoin 'investment opportunity' promising guaranteed returns? How to spot a Bitcoin scam, protect your wallet, and report it in the UK.
- [Crypto Investment Scam UK: Spot a Fake Platform](https://beatthescam.com/guides/crypto-investment-scams-uk-protection/): Approached about a crypto investment with celebrity endorsements or guaranteed returns? Spot a crypto investment scam and protect yourself in the UK.
- [Crypto Recovery Scam UK: A Second Scam to Avoid](https://beatthescam.com/guides/crypto-recovery-scam-uk/): Told your crypto has been recovered after a scam and just needs a fee to claim? Don't pay or share wallet keys. Verify independently.
- [Cryptocurrency Payment Scam UK: Why Unexpected Crypto Demands Are a Red Flag](https://beatthescam.com/guides/cryptocurrency-payment-scam-uk/): Unexpected demands to pay in cryptocurrency are a major scam warning sign. Here's why criminals ask for crypto, and what to do instead.
- [Fake Crypto Exchange UK: Spot a Cloned Trading Platform](https://beatthescam.com/guides/fake-crypto-exchange-uk/): Fake exchanges copy a real platform's branding and let you deposit, even withdraw small amounts, before vanishing. Check the FCA Firm Checker first.
- [NFT Scam UK: Wallet Drainers and Fake Mint Sites](https://beatthescam.com/guides/nft-scam-uk/): A common high-value NFT threat is a 'wallet drainer' site tricking you into signing away access to your wallet. Here's how to check first.

### Email Scams

- [Amazon Scam Emails: How to Spot a Fake Amazon Email (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/amazon-order-scam-email-checklist/): Got an Amazon email about an order problem, refund, or 'account locked'? How to tell a genuine Amazon email from a phishing scam — and check safely.
- [CEO Fraud Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Boss Request](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ceo-fraud-email-scam-uk/): A message appears to come from a senior colleague and requests an urgent payment or sensitive data. Verify it through a separate trusted channel.
- [Companies House Email Scam UK: How to Check and Report a Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/companies-house-email-scam-uk/): Fake Companies House emails use urgent verification, filing or payment claims. Learn how to check a message safely and report phishing in the UK.
- [DVLA Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Tax or Fine Email](https://beatthescam.com/guides/dvla-email-scam-uk/): Got a DVLA email about car tax, a refund, a fine, or your licence? How to spot a fake DVLA email, check safely on GOV.UK, and report it in the UK.
- [Email Account Takeover UK: Recover and Lock It Down](https://beatthescam.com/guides/email-account-takeover-scam-uk/): Recover a compromised email account, remove forwarding rules and reused credentials, and use a passkey or two-step verification to secure it.
- [Festival Lineup Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Presale](https://beatthescam.com/guides/festival-lineup-email-scam-uk/): Got an email about a festival lineup announcement with a presale ticket link? How to spot a fake festival email scam and buy tickets safely.
- [HMRC Tax Rebate Email Scam: Spot a Fake (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hmrc-tax-rebate-email-scam/): An HMRC email saying you're owed a tax rebate, with a link to claim? Real rebates aren't claimed through an email link — how to spot the scam and check safely.
- [HSBC Phishing Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hsbc-phishing-email-scam-uk/): An email claiming to be HSBC asks you to verify your details urgently, or risk suspension? Check it carefully before you click anything.
- [Microsoft Account Suspended Scam Email: How to Spot It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/microsoft-account-suspended-email-scam-uk/): A fake Microsoft email claims unusual activity or suspension and links to a bogus sign-in page. Open your Microsoft account directly instead.
- [NatWest Phishing Emails: Spot a Fake NatWest Email (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/natwest-phishing-email-uk/): A NatWest email about 'unusual activity' or 'verify your account', with a button to click? How to tell a genuine NatWest email from phishing — and check safely.
- [Netflix Billing Email Scam UK: Spot a Fake Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/netflix-billing-email-scam-uk/): An email says your Netflix payment failed and your account will be suspended? Check it before clicking — genuine Netflix never asks this way.
- [PayPal Account Limited Email Scam UK](https://beatthescam.com/guides/paypal-account-limited-email-scam-uk/): An email says your PayPal account is limited and you must verify now? Log in directly instead. Genuine emails use your account name.
- [Santander Email Scam: How to Spot a Fake Bank Email (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/santander-email-scam-uk/): A Santander email about a locked account or 'verify now'? How to spot a fake Santander email, check it safely, and report phishing in the UK.
- [Sextortion Email Scam UK: How to Respond Safely](https://beatthescam.com/guides/sextortion-email-scam-uk/): Sextortion scam emails claim to have compromising footage and demand payment. Learn how to respond, report the email and secure your accounts.
- [TV Licence Scam Email UK: How to Spot a Fake](https://beatthescam.com/guides/tv-licence-email-scam-uk/): Genuine TV Licensing payment emails come from specific sender addresses. Here's how to check a TV Licence email is real before clicking any link.

### Employment Scams

- [Data Entry Job Scams UK: Spot Fake Work-from-Home Offers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/data-entry-job-scam-uk/): A 'data entry' or 'typing' job from home that pays well and asks for an upfront fee or tasks? How to spot the scam and find genuine work safely.
- [Indeed Job Scams UK: How to Spot a Fake Recruiter](https://beatthescam.com/guides/indeed-job-scam-uk/): A great-paying Indeed job that asks for an upfront fee or moves you to WhatsApp? How to spot a fake recruiter and why real employers don't charge you.
- [Job Offer Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'You're Hired' Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/job-offer-scam-uk/): Got an unexpected job offer by text or WhatsApp with great pay and no interview? How to spot a fake job offer, check the employer, and report it in the UK.
- [LinkedIn Job Scam UK: Spot a Fake Recruiter Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/linkedin-job-scam-guide-uk/): An unsolicited LinkedIn message offers a role that seems too easy or too well-paid? Verify the recruiter independently before sharing anything.
- [Mystery Shopper Scam UK: Spot a Fake Cheque Job](https://beatthescam.com/guides/mystery-shopper-scam-uk/): Sent a cheque before you've even started mystery shopping? No genuine company needs you to bank a cheque and wire money on. How to spot the scam.
- [Recruitment Agency Scams UK: Spot a Fake Job Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/recruitment-agency-scam-uk/): A 'recruitment agency' asking for an upfront fee, your bank details, or ID before any real job? How to spot a fake agency and check it's genuine.
- [Remote Work Scam UK: How to Spot a Fake Job Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/remote-work-scam-uk-2026/): Offered a remote job with no real interview and an upfront fee to start? Here's how to tell a genuine offer from a scam one and what to do next.
- [Work From Home Scam UK: Envelope, Kit & Reshipping Cons](https://beatthescam.com/guides/work-from-home-scam-uk/): Asked to pay for a starter kit before your work-from-home job begins? Upfront fees are a serious warning sign. How to spot the scam and report it.

### Fraud & Impersonation

- [Charity Scam UK: Spot a Fake Donation Appeal](https://beatthescam.com/guides/charity-donation-scam-checklist/): Asked to donate to a charity appeal by phone, text, or social media? How to spot a fake charity scam, check it's genuine, and give safely in the UK.
- [Conveyancing Fraud UK: Stop “Friday Afternoon Fraud”](https://beatthescam.com/guides/conveyancing-fraud-uk/): Criminals alter conveyancing emails and redirect completion money. Establish bank details early and verify any change through a trusted channel.
- [Deed Fraud: Protect Property in England and Wales](https://beatthescam.com/guides/deed-fraud-uk-property-scam/): Criminals may impersonate an owner to sell or mortgage a property. HM Land Registry offers alerts and title restrictions in England and Wales.
- [Driveway Cowboy Scam UK: Spot a Fake Contractor](https://beatthescam.com/guides/driveway-cowboy-scam-uk/): An unsolicited caller offers cheap driveway or roof repairs using 'leftover materials'? How to spot a doorstep cowboy trader and report it in the UK.
- [Google Voice Verification Code Scam UK: Don't Share That Code](https://beatthescam.com/guides/google-voice-verification-scam/): Someone asks you to read back a Google verification code to 'prove you're real'? It's a scam to hijack your number. Here's how it works and what to do.
- [How to Spot and Avoid Scams in the UK: The Core Rules](https://beatthescam.com/guides/beatthescamcom-guide-spotting-and-avoiding-uk-consumer-scams/): Every scam relies on the same handful of tricks. Learn the pattern once and you'll recognise it in a call, text, or email you've never seen before.
- [Identity Theft UK: Warning Signs & What to Do](https://beatthescam.com/guides/identity-theft-uk/): Noticed an unrecognised account or a sudden credit-file surprise? Here's how identity theft actually happens in the UK, and what to do about it first.
- [Recovery Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'Get Your Money Back' Firm](https://beatthescam.com/guides/refund-recovery-scam-warning-signs/): Lost money to a scam and now a 'recovery agent' offers to get it back for a fee? How to spot a recovery scam, avoid a second loss, and report it in the UK.
- [WhatsApp 'Hi Mum' Scam UK: Spot a Fake Family Text](https://beatthescam.com/guides/whatsapp-family-emergency-scam/): Got a WhatsApp from 'your child' on a new number needing urgent money? Spot the 'Hi Mum' family impersonation scam, check safely, and get money back.

### Government Impersonation

- [Benefits Fraud Text Scam UK: Spot a Fake DWP Text](https://beatthescam.com/guides/benefits-fraud-text-scam-uk/): Fake DWP texts use benefit reviews or payments to steal personal and bank details. Do not use the link; check through your official benefit account.
- [Companies House Scam Letter UK: Spot a Fake Fee Demand](https://beatthescam.com/guides/companies-house-scam-letter-uk/): Fake Companies House letters demand invented registration or filing fees. Check the official register and current fees before paying or scanning a QR code.
- [Council Housing Scam UK: Spot a Fake Housing Offer](https://beatthescam.com/guides/council-housing-scam-uk/): A criminal claims they can sell a council home, priority or a guaranteed place. Apply and verify offers through the local council's official channels.
- [Fake Court Summons Email UK: Check Before You Panic](https://beatthescam.com/guides/court-summons-scam-email-uk/): An email claims you've an unpaid fine or court date and must act now? Check the HMCTS domain and verify through official court details.
- [HMRC Self Assessment Scam UK: Fake Refund & Tax Bill Texts](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hmrc-self-assessment-scam-uk/): Fake HMRC messages spike around Self Assessment deadlines, claiming a refund or overdue bill. HMRC never asks you to 'confirm' bank details by text.
- [Passport Renewal Scam UK: Spot a Fake HMPO Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/passport-renewal-scam-uk/): A text or email says your passport application needs an urgent extra fee? Check your own application on gov.uk first. How to spot the fake message.
- [Student Finance Scam UK: Spot a Fake SLC Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/student-finance-scam-uk/): Fake Student Finance messages ask for personal, login or bank details. Check your online account directly and report suspicious contact.
- [TV Licence Scam Letter UK: Spot a Fake Demand](https://beatthescam.com/guides/tv-licence-scam-letter-uk/): Got a letter demanding payment for an unpaid TV licence with a threat of prosecution? How to spot a fake TV Licensing letter and report it in the UK.
- [UKVI Visa Scam UK: Spot a Fake Home Office Email](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ukvi-visa-scam-uk/): Got an email claiming to be from UKVI about your visa or immigration application, demanding urgent payment? How to spot a fake UKVI scam and report it.
- [Universal Credit Scams UK: Spot a Fake DWP Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/universal-credit-scam-uk/): A text, call, or 'agent' offering help to claim Universal Credit, a grant, or an advance? How to spot a Universal Credit scam and protect your claim and money.

### Investment & Finance Scams

- [Bond Scam UK: How Fake High-Return Bonds Work](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bond-scam-uk/): Fake or unregulated 'mini-bond' investments promise returns well above the market, then the firm disappears. Here's the FCA's own warning sign.
- [Clone Firm Investment Scam UK: Check Before You Invest](https://beatthescam.com/guides/clone-firm-investment-scam-uk/): A firm gives you contact details that differ from the FCA Register? That's the clone-firm trick — always call back only on the Register's own number.
- [Debt Relief Scam UK: Spot a Fake Debt Help Company](https://beatthescam.com/guides/debt-relief-scam-uk/): Contacted by a company promising to wipe or reduce your debt for an upfront fee? How to spot a debt relief scam, find free help, and report it in the UK.
- [Forex Trading Scam UK: Spot a Fake Broker](https://beatthescam.com/guides/forex-trading-scam-uk/): Promised guaranteed forex returns on social media? Check any broker on the FCA's Firm Checker before you deposit, and learn the warning signs.
- [IVA Scam UK: Spot a Fake Debt Solution Firm](https://beatthescam.com/guides/iva-scam-uk/): Contacted about an IVA that will 'write off most of your debt'? How to spot a fake IVA offer, find genuine advice, and report it in the UK.
- [Land Banking Scam UK: Spot a Fake Land Investment](https://beatthescam.com/guides/land-banking-scam-uk/): Offered cheap land 'certain to get planning permission' as an investment? How to spot a land banking scam, check safely, and report it in the UK.
- [Money Mule Scam UK: Spot a 'Job' Moving Money](https://beatthescam.com/guides/money-mule-scam-uk/): Offered easy money for letting cash pass through your bank account? How to spot a money mule recruitment scam and avoid serious legal trouble in the UK.
- [Pension Cold Call Scam UK: Why It's Illegal to Call](https://beatthescam.com/guides/pension-cold-call-scam-uk/): An unexpected call about your pension? Cold-calling about pensions has been illegal in the UK since January 2019 — hanging up is the safest move.
- [Ponzi Scheme UK Warning: Spot the Recruitment Pattern](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ponzi-scheme-uk-warning/): A Ponzi scheme pays early investors using later investors' money, not real profit, and cannot be sustained indefinitely. Here's what to watch for.
- [Recovery Room Scam UK: A Second Scam After the First](https://beatthescam.com/guides/recovery-room-scam-uk/): Contacted by someone claiming to be the FCA, police, or a solicitor offering to recover money you've already lost? That contact is the scam.
- [Share Fraud UK: Spot a 'Boiler Room' Cold Call](https://beatthescam.com/guides/share-fraud-uk/): Cold-called about shares with a free research report thrown in? The FCA's name for this is a 'boiler room' — check before you invest.

### Marketplace Scams

- [Airbnb Scam UK: Spot a Fake Listing](https://beatthescam.com/guides/airbnb-scam-uk-listings/): Found an Airbnb listing that asks you to pay outside the app before booking? How to spot a fake or hijacked Airbnb listing and book safely in the UK.
- [Autotrader Car Scam UK: Spot Fake Listings & Sellers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/autotrader-car-scam-uk/): A cheap Autotrader car from a seller who can't meet and wants a deposit? Spot a fake listing, avoid 'escrow' cons, and report it in the UK.
- [Depop Scams UK: Spot Fake Sellers & Off-App Payment Cons](https://beatthescam.com/guides/depop-scam-uk/): Buying or selling on Depop? Spot fake sellers, hacked accounts, and 'pay me off-app' cons that strip your buyer protection — and how to report it.
- [eBay Listing Fee Scam UK: Spot a Fake Notice](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ebay-listing-fee-scam-uk/): An email says you owe an unpaid eBay listing fee or your listing will be removed? Check My eBay or Seller Hub directly, not a link.
- [eBay Scams UK: How to Spot a Fake Buyer, Seller or Email](https://beatthescam.com/guides/ebay-buyer-scam-uk/): Asked to pay or deal outside eBay, or got an 'eBay' email about a held payment? How to spot the common eBay scams and keep your money protected.
- [Etsy Scam Sellers UK: Spot Fakes & Buy Safely](https://beatthescam.com/guides/etsy-scam-sellers-uk-guide/): Asked to pay an Etsy seller outside the site to save on fees? That's the biggest scam red flag on the platform. How to spot fakes and buy safely.
- [Facebook Marketplace Fake Buyer Scam UK](https://beatthescam.com/guides/facebook-marketplace-fake-buyer-scam-uk/): Selling on Facebook Marketplace and a 'buyer' sends a fake payment confirmation? How to spot a fake buyer, protect your sale, and report it in the UK.
- [Facebook Marketplace Scam UK: Spot a Fake Seller](https://beatthescam.com/guides/facebook-marketplace-scam-uk/): Buying on Facebook Marketplace and asked to pay by bank transfer before viewing the item? Spot a fake seller, buy safely, and report it in the UK.
- [Gumtree Scams UK: How to Spot and Avoid Fake Listings and Buyers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/gumtree-scam-uk-guide/): Gumtree is legitimate, but scammers use it. Here are the most common Gumtree scams targeting UK buyers and sellers, the warning signs, and how to stay safe.
- [Preloved Scam UK: Spot a Fake Seller or Listing](https://beatthescam.com/guides/preloved-scam-uk/): Buying on Preloved and asked to pay by bank transfer before you can view the item? How to spot a fake Preloved seller, buy safely, and report it.
- [Rightmove Rental Scam UK: Spot Fake Property Listings](https://beatthescam.com/guides/rightmove-rental-scam-uk/): Renting a place you found on Rightmove? How to spot a fake listing or landlord, avoid losing a deposit to a 'pay to hold it' con, and report it in the UK.
- [Shpock Scam UK: Spot a Fake Deal Safely](https://beatthescam.com/guides/shpock-scam-uk/): Asked to pay a deposit before collecting on Shpock? Check the item in person first and keep payment links out of the chat. How to spot a fake deal.
- [Vinted Buyer Scam UK: Spot Fake 'Payment' Cons](https://beatthescam.com/guides/vinted-buyer-scam-uk/): Selling on Vinted and a buyer wants to pay off-app or 'confirm your card'? How to spot a Vinted buyer scam, keep your payment safe, and report it.
- [Vinted Festival Camping Gear Scam: Spot a Fake Seller](https://beatthescam.com/guides/festival-camping-equipment-vinted-scam/): Festival season brings fake tent and camping-gear listings on Vinted. Paying through Vinted keeps you inside its protection process.
- [Vinted Scams UK: Warning Signs for Buyers and Sellers](https://beatthescam.com/guides/vinted-scam-warning-uk/): Buying or selling on Vinted? The main risk on both sides is being pushed off the app — here's how Vinted's protection works and what to watch for.

### Payment Scams

- [Advance Fee Scam UK: Verify Before Paying to Receive Money](https://beatthescam.com/guides/advance-fee-scam-uk/): A fake loan, prize or inheritance is released only after a fee. Verify the organisation independently—some genuine credit brokers can charge disclosed fees.
- [Apple Pay Scam UK: Spot Fake Security Alerts & Texts](https://beatthescam.com/guides/apple-pay-scam-uk/): Got a call, text, or email about 'suspicious Apple Pay activity' or a locked account? How to spot an Apple Pay scam and report it in the UK.
- [Bank Transfer Scams UK: How to Spot a 'Safe Account' Con](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bank-transfer-scam-uk/): Asked to move money to a 'safe account', or to pay by bank transfer under pressure? How to spot a bank-transfer scam, check safely on 159, and claim it back.
- [Chargeback Scam UK: How Chargeback Fraud Works and How to Avoid It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/chargeback-scam-uk/): Chargeback scams let a buyer keep the goods and claim their money back, leaving the seller out of pocket. How chargeback fraud works and how to avoid it.
- [Invoice Fraud UK: How to Verify a Payment Safely](https://beatthescam.com/guides/invoice-fraud-uk-businesses/): A supplier email says their bank details have changed? Always verify by phone on a number you already have on file before you pay the invoice.
- [Invoice Redirection Scam UK: Spot Fake Payment Requests](https://beatthescam.com/guides/invoice-redirection-scam-checklist/): A supplier email says their bank details have changed? Verify it by phone on a number you already have — never one from the email itself.
- [Monzo Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'Suspicious Activity' Alert](https://beatthescam.com/guides/monzo-scam-transfer-uk/): Got a call, text, or in-app message claiming 'suspicious activity' on your Monzo account? How to spot a Monzo scam, check safely, and report it in the UK.
- [Overpayment Scam UK: Do Not Send a Separate Refund](https://beatthescam.com/guides/overpayment-scam-uk/): A buyer claims to have paid too much and wants money sent elsewhere. Verify the payment in your own account and ask the provider to reverse it safely.
- [PayPal Friends and Family Scam: Why Sellers Ask for It](https://beatthescam.com/guides/paypal-friends-family-scam-uk/): PayPal Friends and Family payments are not eligible for Buyer Protection. Use Goods and Services for an eligible purchase and report scam payments promptly.
- [Revolut Scam UK: Spot a Fake 'Security' Contact](https://beatthescam.com/guides/revolut-scam-uk/): A message or call claims to be Revolut security asking you to move money to a 'safe account'? Stop and check inside the Revolut app.
- [Starling Bank Scam UK: Spot a Fake Fraud Alert](https://beatthescam.com/guides/starling-bank-scam-uk/): Got a text, call, or email claiming to be Starling about suspicious activity on your account? How to spot a Starling scam and report it in the UK.
- [Wedding Photographer Scam UK: Verify Before You Book](https://beatthescam.com/guides/wedding-photographer-scam-uk/): A portfolio and social profile can be copied. Verify the photographer, contract and payment recipient, and understand card protection before paying.
- [Wedding Venue Deposit Scam UK: Verify Before Paying](https://beatthescam.com/guides/wedding-venue-deposit-scam-uk/): Verify a venue and any changed bank details through contact information found independently. Card and bank-transfer protections depend on how the loss occurred.
- [Wise Transfer Scam UK: Spot a Fake Wise Message](https://beatthescam.com/guides/wise-transfer-scam-uk/): Got an email or text claiming to be from Wise about a payment or account issue? How to spot a Wise impersonation scam and report it in the UK.

### Phone Scams

- [Amazon Scam Phone Calls UK: How to Spot a Fake Amazon Call](https://beatthescam.com/guides/amazon-phone-call-scam-uk/): Got an unexpected automated 'Amazon' call about an order or account? Treat it as unverified. Here is how to check it safely and stop a phone scam.
- [BT Scam Calls: How to Spot a Fake BT Phone Call (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/bt-broadband-scam-calls-uk/): An unexpected 'BT' call about your router, a refund, or being cut off? How to spot a fake BT caller, and what a genuine BT call will never ask.
- [DVLA Scam Calls: How to Spot a Fake Caller (UK)](https://beatthescam.com/guides/dvla-phone-scam-uk/): An unexpected call claims your vehicle tax has failed or your licence is at risk? Hang up and check your status directly through GOV.UK.
- [HMRC Phone Call Scam UK: Spot a Fake Tax Call](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hmrc-phone-call-scam-uk/): A fake HMRC call threatens arrest or urgent legal action. HMRC may phone or use voice prompts, but it says it will never threaten arrest.
- [HSBC Scam Call UK: Spot a Fake Fraud Team Call](https://beatthescam.com/guides/hsbc-bank-scam-call-uk/): Got a call claiming to be HSBC's fraud team about suspicious activity on your account? How to spot an HSBC scam call, check safely, and report it.
- [National Insurance Scam Call UK: The 'Suspended' Lie](https://beatthescam.com/guides/national-insurance-scam-call-uk/): A robocall claims your National Insurance number is 'suspended' and pushes you to confirm your details. There's no such thing as a suspended NI number.
- [Number Spoofing Scam UK: Spot a Fake Caller ID](https://beatthescam.com/guides/number-spoofing-scam-uk/): Got a call from a number that looked exactly like your bank or a government agency? How caller ID spoofing works and how to stay safe in the UK.
- [Pension Liberation Scam UK: The 55% Tax Trap](https://beatthescam.com/guides/pension-liberation-scam-uk/): Pension liberation offers early access to your pension before 55 — but it can trigger a tax charge of up to 55% of the amount you take out.
- [Police Impersonation Scam UK: Spot a Fake Officer Call](https://beatthescam.com/guides/police-impersonation-scam-call-uk/): A 'police officer' says your money is at risk and you must move it or help an investigation? How to spot the scam and report it in the UK.
